title: Irreducible integer extension by zero vanishing
statement: Let X be an irreducible Noetherian topological space and d a nonnegative integer with dim X <= d [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension]. Assume that for every nonnegative integer e<d, every Noetherian topological space Y with dim Y <= e, every abelian sheaf G on Y, and every nonnegative integer r>e, H^r(Y,G) [def-sc-topological-abelian-cohomology] is zero. Then for every nonnegative integer p>d and every quasi-compact open U of X, H^p(X,j_! Z_U) is zero, where Z_U is the constant integer sheaf on U and j_! is abelian open extension by zero [def-sc-abelian-open-extension-by-zero].

proof.text: If U is empty, extension by zero is zero (its presheaf has empty sums), so all cohomology vanishes.
For nonempty U, if d=0 a proper nonempty closed subset would supply an irreducible closed chain of length one, contradicting the bound. Thus U=X and constant-sheaf acyclicity applies.

For d>0, Z=X\U is a proper closed Noetherian subspace of dimension at most d-1: append the irreducible closed set X to each chain in Z. Restriction of the constant integer sheaf is the constant integer sheaf (canonically on stalks); the open-closed sequence therefore has terms j_!Z_U, Z_X and i_*Z_Z.

For p>d the constant term has zero degree-p cohomology. Closed-immersion comparison and hlower at e=d-1 kill degree p-1 on the closed complement. The long exact sequence kills degree p of the integer extension; p-1>d-1 follows from p>d.

theorem irreducible_integer_extension_vanishing
    (X : TopCat.{u}) [NoetherianSpace X] [IrreducibleSpace X]
    (d : ℕ) (hdim : topologicalKrullDim X ≤ (d : WithBot ℕ∞))
    (hlower : ∀ (e : ℕ), e < d →
      ∀ (Y : Type u) [TopologicalSpace Y] [NoetherianSpace Y]
        (hdimY : topologicalKrullDim Y ≤ (e : WithBot ℕ∞))
        (G : CategoryTheory.Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y) AddCommGrpCat.{u})
        (r : ℕ), e < r → IsZero (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H' G r (⊤ : Opens Y)))
    (p : ℕ) (hp : d < p) (U : Opens X) (hU : IsCompact (U : Set X)) :
    IsZero (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H'
      ((TopCat.Sheaf.abelianOpenExtensionByZero U).obj
        ((constantSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj U))
          AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u} ℤ)))) p
      (⊤ : Opens X))
